title: Vaporesso Luxe X Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Luxe X Pro pod kit from Vaporesso is a highly versatile vape device that offers both an MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping experience, letting you easily switch styles depending on the pod you choose. This is a compact, ergonomic, and durable pod device with a sleek and sophisticated metallic chassis that’s all luxurious curves and smooth corners, feeling truly premium in the hand. Two new additions to the Luxe X Pro kit include a crisp, clear 0.42” OLED screen for keeping track of all your settings and an intuitive and satisfying auto-draw feature in addition to fire button operation. Vaporesso Luxe X Pro Pod Kit is powered by an impressive 1500mAh integrated battery that can push out up to 40W of power . That’s enough battery life to see most vapers through a day’s use, and when it does need recharging, the USB-C connection will get it up to a full charge in no time at all. Vaporesso’s Axon chipset automatically detects the resistance of your chosen pod’s coil providing the optimal wattage for the best draw and flavour. Alternatively, you can manually set the wattage using the +/- buttons beneath the screen. To prevent misfires, 3 quick clicks locks the device . The Vaporesso Luxe X refillable pods employ a fixed-coil system that eliminates the need to swap out coils. Instead, when the pod’s integrated coil begins to lose flavour, you simply replace it with a fresh pod. The pods have a capacity of 2ml can be refilled from a sealed port at the bottom of the pods, and are held in place with strong magnets. You can also rotate the pod 180-degrees for a tighter or airier airflow. Vaporesso’s new Corex Coil technology, which features of a Morph-Mesh coil structure with Cumulus Cotton wicking, ensures incredible flavour whichever pod you choose, while SSS Leak-Resistant technology helps prevent leaks and condensation buildup. The kit includes a 0.8ohm fixed-coil pod which is ideal for MTL vaping and High-PG , 50/50 and Nic Salt E-Liquids , while the 0.6ohm mesh coil pod offers a slightly looser RDL-like experience that truly brings high-VG, sub-ohm vaping firmly into pod territory. Discover our vape juice online and find a flavour that complements this kit. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
